tools.name: create_signing_envelope
tools.description: Create an unsigned FreeSign draft when the user has a locally computed PDF SHA-256 hash and wants a signing link for that document. If no computed hash is available, the user can start directly at https://free-sign.com/ and select their PDF there without calculating a hash themselves. Do not invent a hash. Returns a signing link; the user opens it and selects the matching local PDF to continue. Creating a draft does not sign a document or send email. This tool does not upload PDF bytes to FreeSign; signing requires a browser session key, identity verification, and explicit consent.

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original PDF bytes, computed locally by the user or agent.

tools.name: verify_document_hash
tools.description: Look up FreeSign envelopes by their stored document SHA-256. Returns up to 20 matching records, newest first, with evidence identifiers and their stored status (draft, otp_sent, signed, finalized, or expired). An unknown hash returns an empty matches array. Use the original PDF hash for a draft created through MCP from that hash. If a direct browser or older signing flow rewrote the PDF, use the hash of the normalized signing base shown by FreeSign. A match alone does not establish signature validity. This tool does not upload PDF bytes to FreeSign.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve public verification evidence for a known FreeSign envelope ID: envelope status, signed final payload, signer receipts, and OpenTimestamps anchor metadata. Signed receipt payloads can include the signer's declared name. Drafts may have no receipts. Returns envelope_not_found for an unknown ID. Never returns PDF bytes.

tools.name: get_ots_proof
tools.description: Retrieve the stored OpenTimestamps proof as base64 for an envelope ID and anchor ID obtained from get_receipt. The result identifies pending or Bitcoin-confirmed status and the committed hash. It does not submit a new timestamp. Verify the proof independently with OpenTimestamps software; pending proofs are not yet Bitcoin-confirmed.

tools.name: verify_audit_chain
tools.description: Check the stored audit-event hash chain for a known FreeSign envelope ID. FreeSign recomputes event hashes, links, and sequence continuity, and cross-checks a signer-attested head when its signature verifies. Returns the integrity verdict and per-event check results. Chain integrity alone does not establish legal validity or inspect PDF content.
